newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi Electric Supply Corp in the red.
newsitem.headline: Karachi Electric Supply Corp in the red.

text.p: Half year ended December 31, 1996 (in million rupees)
Loss before tax 2,286 vs 654 million profit
Interim dividend nil vs nil per 10-rupee share

NOTE - Full name is Karachi Electric Supply Corp Ltd. It is a state organisation which the government has been planning to privatise for the last five years. The firm says the major reason for the loss are higher fuel cost and power purchase due to increase in fuel prices. There is no closure of books as the firm has not announced any interim dividend. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
